decisions.reason: As a consumer-facing superfood line with weak continued visibility and looser fit to the firm's industrial technology core, it likely fell below aspiration levels and its resources are better redirected to more promising sustainability ventures.

Although it was only mentioned rather than heavily promoted, these modular waste-to-energy extensions are tightly tied to the established business, likely require limited extra slack, and are satisfactory enough to retain as a complement for existing customers.

This product had clear dedicated market presentation from launch, strong strategic fit with the firm's waste-to-energy capabilities, and in a growing innovative industry management would continue backing it despite uncertainty.

Its move from a mention to its own page suggests improving traction, and as a close extension of the firm's circular-conversion technologies it is worth keeping within the firm's problemistic search and growth path.
